configurePresets.name: c-legacy
configurePresets.description: ENABLE_CPP_UPGRADES=OFF. Builds mg exactly like upstream with the system Apple Clang. No C++ / modules involved.

configurePresets.name: cpp
configurePresets.description: ENABLE_CPP_UPGRADES=ON. Drives BOTH C and C++ with MacPorts clang-21 so the extern "C" bridge links one consistent toolchain, and points CMake at the (suffix-free) clang-scan-deps it needs for C++20 module scanning.

configurePresets.name: cpp-tsan
configurePresets.description: Same toolchain as cpp, with ENABLE_TSAN=ON to gate the FM-ASYNC-STATUS monitor thread (snapshot/modeline races) and any other concurrency. The CMakeLists ENABLE_TSAN block instruments every target and, on macOS, links the clang-21 instrumentation against Apple's OS-matched runtime (path derived from xcrun) because the MacPorts runtime crashes at startup on macOS 26.5.

configurePresets.name: cpp-linux
configurePresets.description: Native Linux build (Arch primary, Alpine too). Uses the distro clang/clang++ in PATH; CMake auto-detects clang-scan-deps next to it. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 lets the fetched doctest configure under CMake 4.x. Used by the docker/ images and for native builds: `cmake --preset cpp-linux && cmake --build --preset cpp-linux && ctest --preset cpp-linux`.

configurePresets.name: cpp-linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: cpp-linux with ENABLE_TSAN=ON. On Linux the toolchain's own TSan runtime works directly -- no Apple-runtime rpath dance needed (that path is macOS-only in the CMakeLists ENABLE_TSAN block).
